piezime: Main plan annex 16 (p. 50–53): 49 assembly places grouped by town/parish (nr = group number, shared by rows); nosaukums = 'Pulcēšanās objekts' + ' — ' + 'Pulcēšanās vieta'; no coordinates; Lībagu (group 15) and Valdgale (group 20) rows are broken across lines by the conversion. Annex 18 (p. 55): accommodation sites only as free-text per town/parish (no addresses, capacities or beds); adrese holds just the town/parish column, several rows bundle multiple buildings, and rows marked 'nav'/'-' (Abava, Balgale, Ģibuļi, Ķūļciems, Lube) were skipped. The 47 'lemums247_pielikums_*' files are hazard action sheets with no lists.
